summary: Private pilot: installer cannot pull container images in locked-down VPC (ECR/S3 private endpoints missing)
description:
Customer (Private pilot) reports Redwood Private installer fails during bootstrap when attempting to pull container images. Customer VPC is "locked down" (no Internet egress; NAT disabled; all traffic must stay private via VPC endpoints).

Issue summary
- The installer cannot pull images from ECR (and related layers via S3) inside customer VPC.
- Suspected missing/incorrect VPC endpoints and/or private DNS settings.

Impact
- Blocks initial Private installation (pilot milestone at risk).

Customer context / constraints
- No public egress allowed (no IGW/NAT).
- Route53 Resolver is present; customer expects Private DNS to be used.
- Deploying via Terraform alpha modules (redwood-private-vpc wrapper) with some endpoint toggles disabled based on internal baseline.

What we need from customer
- AWS region(s) used for deploy.
- Output of installer preflight (if available) and any node-level logs.
- Confirm which endpoints exist: ECR (api/dkr), S3 gateway, CloudWatch Logs.

Initial hypothesis
- Missing interface endpoints for com.amazonaws.us-east-1.ecr.api and com.amazonaws.us-east-1.ecr.dkr and/or missing S3 gateway endpoint on private subnets route tables.
- Private DNS disabled on ECR endpoints causing resolution to public endpoints (blocked).

resolution:
Root cause: customer deployed Redwood Private into a locked-down VPC with no Internet egress, but did not have the full required AWS private connectivity for image pulls.

Specifically:
- Missing VPC interface endpoint for ECR Docker registry (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.ecr.dkr)
- Private DNS disabled on ECR endpoints (caused resolution to public hostnames / failed DNS)
- S3 gateway endpoint was not associated with the route tables used by the node subnets (layers could not be fetched)

Fix/workaround applied (customer side):
- Provisioned both ECR interface endpoints (ecr.api and ecr.dkr) in the node subnets and enabled Private DNS
- Updated endpoint security group to allow inbound 443 from node SG
- Associated S3 gateway endpoint with the private/isolated subnet route tables
- Re-ran installer; install succeeded

Follow-ups:
- Docs updates to explicitly list endpoints + route table requirements (see eng-private-deployments/deployment-guides/aws-vpc-terraform-quickstart-alpha; related docs work referenced in redwood-docs/pr-912)
- Installer preflight improvements to catch missing ecr.dkr + S3 gateway RT association and show actionable errors (related: redwood-private-installer/pr-388, pr-389)
